blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – The prosecution in the International Criminal Court (ICC) is asking a trial chamber to admit three more individuals as witnesses in the case against former President Rodrigo Duterte for supposedly having knowledge of alleged drug war killings by police officers in Bulacan province. In its 14-page page filing dated Oct. 7 but released only early Tuesday, the prosecution identified P-1370, P-1393 and P-1416, as potential witnesses that had prior recorded testimonies pertaining to alleged extrajudicial killings in Central Luzon.
